budget.bound: 6 projects x one invocation x 420000 tokens x $25/M. No retry or fallback; conventional references use no provider calls.

continuation.cost_and_time: Include original two failed-project times and usage. Digit continuation active time is added; interruption-inclusive wall span is separately reported. Reused scalar/batch results retain original provenance.
continuation.reason: 13 scalar actions (capture + 12 seeds) x 60 + one batch x 480 + two heldout actions x 60 = 1380, not 1320. Native budget charges full timeout permanently. Numeric smoke had omitted heldout actions. This is a harness defect, not model failure or a Core defect.

batch.scope: Exploratory follow-up prompted by measured per-decision overhead in ongoing V3. One prospectively fixed model-planned batch of at most eight candidates per task/split; compare with completed V3 ordinary-history A and frozen random-search references. No V3 model proposals or heldout outcomes are supplied to this model. Same familiar datasets; not a new independent benchmark or randomized contemporaneous latency comparison. Closed-boundary continuation after the batch harness underreserved one 60-second heldout action. Digits proposals are reused unchanged with no new model request. Other four slots are called once. Stopped original CPU scopes and records remain unchanged.

data_audit.scope: Data construction audit, not a population-generalization guarantee.

source_read_abba.scope: One closed real native-CPU project, two reads per implementation; local source-qualification improvement, not model research-quality evidence.

unit_validation.test_environment: Actual isolated Core/Pro module paths asserted; normal signed Pro license loaded without exposing its value. Initial collection without a license failed; a subsequent helper accidentally imported baseline modules and correctly failed four new regression cases. Final two isolated Pro invocations passed all 301 selected tests.

money_scope: Returned-usage price estimates, not invoices. Earlier unknown fees remain unknown; all earlier reservations including unused/superseded batches retained. CPU and human/controller work are timed, not monetized.

audit.scope: Read-only audit of original worker numeric-type ambiguity; twelve fresh CPU fits, development only. No model calls and no heldout performance used to choose configurations. Original integer-seed loss reproduced before testing float 1.0.

scope: Exploratory actual CPU ML research with model-planned configurations, cheap fixed search, rolling factual notes, and a one-decision batch follow-up. Not a general scientific-capability benchmark.
time_scope: Per-project wall starts at setup and ends after heldout/closure. Digits batch active sums original stopped run and CPU continuation; separate elapsed span retains interruption/repair wait. All-run span includes intervening fixes but excludes work before first retained run and after final run. Project sums overlap and are not elapsed study time.

unique_execution_audit.includes: All archived ML stages, stopped runs, random references, all smokes including final heldout smoke and CPU-only continuations. Reused random projects counted once; repeated numerical fits count as distinct fits. Development-only numeric diagnostic adds twelve separately recorded fits.
